parole.significato: A national folk dance common in regions pertaining to South Slavic people, performed in a circle.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Serbo-Croatian kolo and Slovene kolo, from Proto-Slavic *kolo (“wheel”).

parole.significato: A type of female nature spirit in Slavic mythology, similar in some ways to a fairy or nymph.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Serbo-Croatian víla and Slovene vila.
